description: R-MFDN experiment matrix. Axes: protocol p1 (official IDForge split) / p2 (identity-disjoint); identity i1 (identity reference on) / i3 (reference off). cross_modal is always m1, the R-MFDN progressive cross-attention fusion. A run is named <cross_modal>_<identity>_<protocol>_<modalities>, e.g. m1_i1_p1_VAT.
